title: PmpoEvolverState
description: Strategy router state for the pmpo-evolver skill — tracks perspective selection, competitor data, learning signals, and evolver lessons across sessions

evolution_name.description: Name of the evolution run; must match the iterative-evolver evolution_name for cross-referencing

perspective.description: Which evolution perspective the router selected or was configured for

perspective_cursor.description: Tracks progress through multiple perspectives when mode=combined

last_scanned.description: When the competitor registry was last scanned

learning_signals.description: Normalized feedback signals collected from all configured sources

id.description: Unique identifier for this signal (UUID recommended)

source_ref.description: Repository, URL, or file path the signal was collected from

signal.description: Human-readable 1-2 sentence summary of what the signal means

count.description: Number of occurrences (e.g., open issues matching label)

examples.description: Up to 5 concrete examples from the source

model_used.description: liter-llm class (small|medium|frontier) or 'none' used to classify this signal

idea_origin.description: How the current evolution idea was originated

rationale.description: Why this idea was selected for the current cycle

evolver_lessons.description: Strategic direction lessons accumulated from post-cycle dreaming

lesson.description: What we learned about product direction in 1-2 sentences

origin_cycle.description: Which iterative-evolver cycle produced this lesson

evidence.description: What in the cycle journal or reflection supports this lesson

impact_on_next_cycle.description: How this lesson should change what we plan in the next cycle

model_routing.description: liter-llm model routing configuration for this evolver run

policy.description: Which model routing policy to apply. 'liter-llm' = use class-based routing; 'harness-native' = use the session model for all tasks; 'frontier-all' = route everything to frontier regardless of cost

class_map.description: Override map from phase-key to model alias. E.g. {'evolver-competitive-scan': 'frontier', 'evolver-carry-forward': 'small'}
